text:
[Council File 26-1289-S1; CD 10]
Mitigated Negative Declaration, No. ENV-2025-5195-MND, Mitigation Measures, and Mitigation Monitoring Program, pursuant to Sections 21082.1(c)(3) and 21081.6 of the California Public Resources Code and California Environmental Quality Act Guidelines Section 15074(b), and related Findings; report from the Los Angeles City Planning Commission (LACPC); and appeals filed by: 1) Barbara Calloway; 2) Curtis Clark; 3) Longwood Reynolds Trust, by Edward J. Campbell, Trustee; 4) Eugene Jones, James Draffen, and Jorge Rafael; and 5) Behnaz Gabay, Avi Gabay, and Daniel Gabay, from the determination of the LACPC in: 1) Approving, pursuant to Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC) Chapter 1A Section 13B.2.2, a Class 2 Conditional Use to permit storage uses within 500 feet of a R Zone; and 2) Approving, pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1A Section 13B.2.4, a Project Review for a development project which creates, or results in, an increase of 50,000 gross square feet or more of non-residential floor area; for the demolition and removal of the existing one-story warehouse building and two surface parking lots; for the construction, use, and maintenance of a seven-story self-storage facility for household goods encompassing a floor area of 161,645 square feet, the self-storage facility would feature storage units across each floor level, a 954-square-foot office area, a 608-square-foot lobby, a 376-square-foot community room/multi-purpose room, five vehicular parking spaces, 36 bicycle parking spaces, and two loading spaces and would operate between 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m., daily; for the properties located at 4802 – 4828 West San Vicente Boulevard, subject to modified Conditions of Approval; and adoption of project findings.
Applicant: David Kelly, Westport Properties Inc.
Representative: Dana Sayles, Three6ixty
Case No. CPC-2025-5194-HD-CU2-PR-ZC-1A
Environmental No. ENV-2025-5195-MND
